title: This Chinese Village Was Built in the Shape of an Ox | China Travel Expert
description:
An entire village in China was laid out in the shape of an ox - and people have lived inside it for centuries.

Hongcun (宏村), in the Huangshan foothills of Anhui, was planned around an ox. A hill at the western edge is the head, two old trees on it are the horns, the houses form the body, and a network of water channels winding through the village carries fresh water past the doors — the 'intestines'. The crescent Moon Pond at the centre and the larger South Lake to the south complete the body plan. Hongcun was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage list in 2000, together with nearby Xidi.

🧭 Expert Tip: come to Moon Pond at first light — before the tour groups arrive, the white walls and red lanterns mirror perfectly in the still water (the pond many recognise from 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon').

安徽宏村整座村子按“牛”的形状布局：山是牛头，两棵古树是牛角，水圬是牛肠，月沼和南湖是牛胃——2000年与西递一起列入世界遗产。
